title: Navigating the Pivot: Confidence in Uncertainty
summary: A strategic seven-module program for professionals facing career change. Whether voluntary (pivot) or involuntary (redundancy), career change triggers deep anxiety about identity and worth. This program uses CBT to challenge limiting beliefs, manage the fear of the unknown, and build the resilience needed to sell your value to the world.

modules.title: Module 1 • The Anatomy of the Pivot
modules.overview: We validate the stress: Changing careers is a top life stressor. It threatens our security and identity. We map the 'Cycle of Transition': Denial -> Anxiety -> Exploration -> Integration. Identifying the 'Why.' Moving away from pain (hating the old job) vs. moving toward pleasure (wanting the new one). The 'Safe Harbor' concept. Creating psychological safety nets while you explore.
takeaways: Anxiety is not a sign you are making a mistake; it is a sign you are doing something new.
You need a 'Toward' motivation, not just an 'Away' motivation.
Transition is a process, not an event.
exercises: The Panic Dump: Write down every fear you have about this change. Get it out of your head.
The North Star: Write a paragraph about what your ideal work life looks like (not the job title, but the feeling/day-to-day).
homework: Share your 'North Star' with a supporter.
Create a 'Financial Runway' plan to reduce survival anxiety.

modules.title: Module 2 • Identity Crisis: Who Am I?
modules.overview: We confuse 'What I do' with 'Who I am.' Losing a title feels like losing the self. We use CBT to separate Worth from Work. Identifying your 'Essence' skills vs. your 'Role' skills. Reframing the narrative. You are not 'unemployed'; you are 'consulting' or 'pivoting.'
takeaways: You are not your business card.
Your value is intrinsic, not role-dependent.
You can control your narrative.
exercises: The 'I Am' Exercise: Complete the sentence 'I am...' 10 times without using a job title.
Values Audit: What values were violated in your old career? What values must be honored in the new one?
homework: Write a new bio that focuses on your skills and mission, not your past titles.

modules.title: Module 3 • Crushing Limiting Beliefs
modules.overview: The 'Inner Critic' gets loud during transitions. 'I'm too old,' 'I'm not qualified,' 'I'm a fraud.' Cognitive Restructuring for Imposter Syndrome. The 'Evidence Board.' collecting proof of your competence. Reframing 'Experience Gap' as 'Fresh Perspective.'
takeaways: Imposter syndrome is a sign of growth.
You don't need to be 100% qualified to start.
Limiting beliefs are hypotheses, not facts. Test them.
exercises: Thought Court: Put a limiting belief on trial. 'I'm too old.' What is the evidence for? What is the evidence against? What is the verdict?
The Transferable List: List 5 skills from your old life that apply to the new one.
homework: Catch and flip 3 limiting beliefs this week.
Ask 3 colleagues what they think your superpower is.

modules.title: Module 4 • The Value Proposition
modules.overview: Moving from 'Begging' to 'Offering.' Shifting the mindset from 'Please hire me' to 'Here is how I can help you.' Crafting your 'Story of Self.' How to explain the pivot logically. Confidence building through preparation. Owning your gap. If you took time off, own it.
takeaways: Confidence attracts opportunity.
You are a solution to someone's problem.
Your story is your most powerful asset.
exercises: The Elevator Pitch: Write a 30-second explanation of your pivot that sounds intentional, not accidental.
Benefit Translation: Take a feature of your background (e.g., 'I was a teacher') and translate it into a business benefit (e.g., 'I am expert at managing stakeholders and simplifying complex info').
homework: Practice your pitch on a friend.

modules.title: Module 5 • Resilience to Rejection
modules.overview: You will hear 'No.' You will be ghosted. This module is about 'Rejection Resilience.' Decoupling rejection from worth. 'It's not a fit' vs 'I am worthless.' The 'No' Quota. Gamifying rejection. Aim to get 100 'No's to get to the 'Yes.' Self-Compassion during the search.
takeaways: Rejection is redirection.
Ghosting is about their bad systems, not your value.
You only need one 'Yes'.
exercises: The Rejection Ritual: Create a ritual for when you get a 'No.' (e.g., 5 minutes of venting, then delete the email and play a hype song).
The 'Not Yet' Reframing: Add 'yet' to every rejection.
homework: Apply for a 'Reach' role just to practice being brave.

modules.title: Module 6 • Networking for Introverts (and Anxious People)
modules.overview: Reframing networking from 'Selling' to 'Learning' and 'Curiosity.' The 'Informational Interview' strategy. Low stakes connection. Managing social anxiety. Preparation and the 'Host Mentality.' Follow-up without feeling annoying.
takeaways: Networking is just making friends.
People love to talk about themselves; ask questions.
Curiosity kills anxiety.
exercises: The curiosity questions: Prepare 5 great questions to ask anyone.
The Digital Coffee: Reach out to 2 people on LinkedIn for a 15-minute virtual coffee.
homework: Send a thank-you note that adds value (e.g., send them an article).

modules.title: Module 7 • Launching the New Chapter
modules.overview: Integration. You have the job (or the path). Now, how to land? Managing 'New Job Anxiety.' The first 90 days. Setting boundaries early. Don't burn out trying to prove yourself. Celebrating the journey.
takeaways: You belong in the room.
Ask questions; nobody expects you to know everything on Day 1.
You reinvented yourself. You can do anything.
exercises: The First 90 Days Plan: Set learning goals, not just performance goals.
The Victory Lap: Do something to celebrate your courage.
homework: Write a letter to your past self thanking them for taking the risk.

aiSupport.systemPrompt: Help the user apply one concrete module step at a time. Do not diagnose. Escalate urgent safety concerns to emergency care.
